featured_reviews.review_text: I was here by 6pm and the aunty here greets with a genuine smile and is approachable. description: Madh Islands famous Bollywood Stars boasts a large area with private seating booths, serving quality Indian and Chinese cuisine with Top Tier hospitality. Perfect spot for a quick fun getaway with a lush green view and a quirky Bollywood theme. Bookings are available for private events, parties or shoots.

featured_reviews.name: Kiran Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text:
Actual Photo of the place.. No information regarding alternative place or restaurant has been shifted is shared, just a simple place is under renovation and this is the current was informed.. also turning off comments on review seems you guys want the review to be tailored according to your views.
Ps: This is not a rude review but an actual update for the place so that people are not misguided by “previous” pictures
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
No comments have been turned off sir. You are free to voice your opinion. You could have atleast given a chance before posting so harshly. 
I have served my guests with utmost love and respect in my old property for a decade and because of road widening had to make a shift. 
Sad to see such rude behaviour.
Hope you have found your desired dining place in Madh Island.
Thank you and have a wonderful evening.

featured_reviews.name: Brandee Westveer
featured_reviews.review_text: Bollywood Stars gets a 10+ for food flavors, preparation and delivery of hot food! We are American and the owner Krishma got our taste and spice just right!!! We like spice but not too hot.  We got Butter Chicken, Dal fry, paneer made in a spinach sauce (forgot the name), Biryani chicken, rice, garlic cheese naan, homemade lime sodas, and more, plus she sent some desert but I am not sure what the were called little round donut like balls soaked in warm syrup! Everything was so delicious! Everything was delivered hot! When we are in Mumbai we will definitely come back to meet Krishma in person, she was so sweet and lovely on the phone! Order or eat at Bollywood stars 🌟 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟! 100%worth your time and great value too! So sorry we ate and forgot to take photos!

featured_reviews.name: Srinjoy Guha
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the best restaurants in madh island. As the place is a bit far from main city, anyone visiting madh island must try this restaurant. Clearly labelled and segregated menu is provided. Food quality is also very good and available at quite a reasonable price. We took dinner for 2 consecutive days there when we visited madh island. All Indian dishes are available and satisfied with their food and service.

experience_details.value: Vegetarian options, Dietary restrictions, Parking, Kid-friendliness, Wheelchair accessibility

featured_reviews.name: Francis Creado
featured_reviews.review_text:
A must come restaurant if your own your visit to the madh Islands. The food is amazing.. the Aroma of the food gets you drooled 🤤. The staff is very friendly. They recommend the tastiest delicacies of the chef.
Our all time favourite is the Prawns Tandoori and the Chicken Malai Tandoori. Chicken lollipops are just fantastic.

My personal suggestion is to visit this place during dinner  time as the place is completely lit up with wonderful lights and its not so hot. The seating is mostly inside a beautiful shack and makes it a little cozy having your own personal space. No Drinks and smoking allowed inside the premises.
As the name says Bollywood stars so is the music. Pure bollwood.

Lastly i wud say that it's the wonderful food and the beautiful ambience that keeps getting me all the time to this place whenever I visit the madhislnds.

featured_reviews.name: Niraj Vijay Patil
featured_reviews.review_text: Sometimes used for shootings this restaurant is nice place to have a dinner. Since we visited it for lunch, the place was hot as it has open sittings with small huts. But, one can imagine the ambience in night. The food was great and service was quick too. Really recommended for dinner if one is visiting Madh Island.

featured_reviews.name: Prathama Mohanty
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had been here for dinner during our stay in madh Island.
Hut themed restaurant, each hut has some Bollywood stars photos.
You can choose to sit in hut or open space. Recommended to visit at night as it's a open space.
Coming to food, they have varities of options in their menu. We had ordered chicken lollipop, Tawa prawns fry, cheesy chicken kabab, chicken fingers, dimsum, lemon ice tea.
Delicious food, reasonable price, quantity and quality was upto mark.
Service was lil slow. Apart from that we had a nice experience.
A must try out place if you are in madh Island.

featured_reviews.name: Nimish Naik
featured_reviews.review_text:
A quick google search for nearby restaurants during our stay at madh Island led us to this amazing Hut themed restaurant called "Bollywood Stars".

We were given a warm welcome by Mr Gulzar who attended us and recommended some of the most popular dishes the restaurant has to offer.

We tried Surmai tawa fry, Tandoor prawns, Malai tandoori kebabs, Burnt chilli chicken pot rice, gulab jamun. We absolutely loved the tandoor prawns, malai tandoori kebabs and the pot rice.

Great service by Mr Gulzar. Highly recommended. Can't wait to visit again!

featured_reviews.name: Maanta Dewan
featured_reviews.review_text:
A great place located in Madh Island. We called for delivery from here and the food was well packaged.
This is what we ordered:
Bharwan mushrooms
Hara bhara kebab
Paneer tikka masala
Dal tadka
Jeera rice
Chicken angara masala
Chicken tikka roll
Roomali roti: 2
Tawa paratha: 1
Tandoori roti: 2
Fresh lime soda: 2
Honey noodles + icecream: 2

Everything was quite tasty and filling. The rotis were soft even after reheating and I absolutely loved the mushrooms, paneer tikka masala and kebabs. They have a long menu and a lot of options in North Indian and Chinese in both veg and non veg. My family loved it and I'm sure so will yours ☺️
Looking forward to visiting this place soon and trying the Chinese dishes here as well.

P.S. I also post updates on Instagram (maanta_d)
Happy hogging 🍴

featured_reviews.review_text:
Now, I know why his dabeli is popular. We ordered four dabeli, of different variety and all were worth. So, we ordered Jain garam, Vaishnav garam, daana and meethi dabeli. The amazing part of Jain dabeli was it had raw banana stuffing with the usual ingredients and let me tell you it was damn tasty. Earlier, I was little sceptical but when I tasted it, all my doubts were cleared. Vaishnav was also very good and others too.
Another thing I liked is packaging. He doesn't pack them in newspapers, which is not good for our health owing to the ink it has.
All in all, this is the best place if you are craving for dabeli.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much for your kind words and showering love for our products.. 😊 Do try our Kutchi Kadak Misal 👍

Garam Butter Dabeli - Saada Dabeli, very nice and tasty.
Cheese Dabeli -  Dabeli with green masala and cheese in it. Juts awesome. Had cheese dabeli first time and loved it.
Rajdhani Dabeli - As per description, this is a very spicy dabeli. I loved it. Perfect spicy and tasty.
Chatni Pav - School ki yaad wala chatni pav. Tasty.

featured_reviews.name: Saahil Ledwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tried the Dahi Puri and Paani Puri at Ramsukh — both were absolutely worth it! The Dahi Puri was fresh, creamy, and loaded with flavors, while the Paani Puri had that perfect tangy-spicy kick. The puris were crisp and the fillings generous, making every bite enjoyable.

Service was quick, hygiene was maintained, and the taste definitely lived up to the hype. A great spot for chaat cravings — must try if you’re around!

featured_reviews.name: Saral Uttamani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Great place for chat, located in Adarsh. I've been going here since last 4 years and the taste hasn't changed yet. Shops in and around it have changed, but Ramsukh is still here. You get variety of things ranging from Pani Puri, dahi puri, BHEL, chat, toast.

In terms of cost, it's is reasonable and decently priced. I wouldn't say cheap, but can't call it expensive either. Quality of food is great. Given you the feeling of authentic Mumbai chat.

There is only outdoor setting, to be frank, only mostly take away. There's literally just one table to sit. Ambience isn't that good, but the Adarsh area is very sophisticated in Kandivali.

Overall: 4.5/5, as they could improve on the seating arrangement. Great for take aways.

Must try: Cheese chilli toast

featured_reviews.review_text: If you want best chat and sandwich in malad so this is perfect place for u. Highly recommend to try Pani puri , Sev puri , cheese chilli sandwich, Cheese Patrice sandwich and much more also price are very affordable. Very good quality and quantity. Must visit place

featured_reviews.name: Mayur
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you want a short escape from Mumbai’s endless traffic, crowded streets, and fast-paced routine, then Madh Island offers exactly that. Tucked away on the northern edge of the city, this coastal destination feels surprisingly detached from Mumbai despite being within city limits. The journey itself whether by road or via the ferry near Versova Beach adds to the charm and makes the place feel like a hidden getaway.

What stands out most about Madh Island is its peaceful atmosphere. Unlike Juhu or Girgaon Chowpatty, the beaches here are far less commercialized and considerably less crowded. Places such as Erangal Beach, Dana Pani Beach, and Madh Beach are perfect for long walks, watching sunsets, or simply sitting by the sea and enjoying the sound of the waves. The rustic fishing villages, coconut trees, old bungalows, and coastal roads give the area a unique charm that is becoming increasingly rare in Mumbai.

The island is not without its flaws. Several visitors mention that cleanliness can vary depending on the season and crowd levels, and some stretches of the beach may have litter or a slight smell associated with fishing activities. Road conditions and traffic during peak hours can also be frustrating, especially while leaving after sunset. However, most people agree that the tranquility, greenery, and open spaces more than compensate for these shortcomings.

Overall, Madh Island is one of Mumbai’s most underrated destinations. It is not a luxury beach town or a perfect tourist hotspot, but that is exactly what makes it special. If you are looking for a peaceful evening, a scenic drive, a weekend staycation, or simply a place to disconnect from the chaos of city life, Madh Island delivers a refreshing experience that feels worlds away from Mumbai while still being a part of it.

As of November 2025, road is under construction at some stretches. Since it’s a two-lane road and one side is closed in some stretches, it gets chaotic when everyone leaves after sunset. Try to head back around 6 pm to avoid the rush. It took us 2 hours to reach malad from the beach.

customer_updates.name: Pushpita Barui
customer_updates.text: I ordered the chicken roll from Kusum Rolls and it was really good—fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. The spicy & sour kasundi sauce just took it to another level and brought everything together beautifully. What I loved most was that it tasted just like the chicken rolls from my hometown, with that authentic, nostalgic flavor. Definitely satisfying and worth ordering again. 🤌👍

featured_reviews.name: Zulfikar Ali
featured_reviews.review_text:
A big bite!
Kusum rolls is something we all should definitely try, fully loaded with chicken and egg. I tried their single egg chicken roll which was absolutely delicious and the paratha was nicely cooked and the fillings were really juicy.
They have veg, egg, chicken and mutton options.

Overall Taste - 8/10

Cost- ₹120

Happy Eatings!

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Uchil
featured_reviews.review_text:
The rolls here are absolutely to die for! In the MaKaBo area, there aren’t too many good Kathi/Kolkata roll spots, so Kusum Roll really feels like a savior for anyone craving that legit taste.

My visit this time was pretty interesting. We’ve all heard of the classic “double egg double chicken,” but I actually spotted a triple egg triple chicken on the menu! The name itself was tempting, but the price was just as over-the-top, so I decided to stick to my trusty double chicken roll instead.

One small piece of advice for fellow customers: if you’re ordering on Swiggy or Zomato and adding special cooking instructions, please type them in Hindi and English. The staff kept asking customers to repeat their instructions, and honestly, your phone keyboard already gives you the option, so why not? Save everyone the drama and your roll will thank you.

featured_reviews.name: Karuna Chatterjee
featured_reviews.review_text: They make veg and non veg in the same tawa and even inform that to the customers but this is actually against the rule set for restaurants to maintain basic hygeine that veg and non veg has to be separate. So the one star is that they can't be trusted for hygeine
